title: B107B - B107B
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Faulty Parking Aid sensor taking down the entire circuit
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  the wiring and any connectors or splice points using Factory Repair Information
Kontrol edin:  the Parking Aid sensors for signs of damage or incorrect replacement parts
technicalNotes: When B107B - Rear Parking Aid Sensör Okuma Değerleri(s) - Open Circuit is found in the 4M/F7 Chassis Q7 verify that the spliced power from J519 to all of the rear parking aid sensors is not corroded.
